items.title: M0: Review scope and source inventory recorded
items.context: Plan M0.a-M0.e: confirm the canonical Proofbound root via lattice session_brief; inventory milestone ledger/status command surfaces via rg; inventory source docs and existing tests/smokes; record stale or retired-root documents that must not drive implementation truth. Output: trusted source map section in the findings report.

items.title: M1: Read-only status boundary review completed
items.context: Plan M1.a-M1.f: check allowed argument keys for milestone_status; verify unexpected keys fail before story reads; verify missing ledger produces a report not a write; verify status output launches no commands or reviewers, writes no evidence or lifecycle facts, and never claims DONE or production readiness. Output: boundary finding or pass.

items.title: M2: Ledger write contract review completed
items.context: Plan M2.a-M2.f: review milestone_ledger_set and milestone_ledger_add lifecycle phase policy and ownership classification; review ledger hash and candidate/confirmed state behavior; review whether direct writes can accidentally become confirmed gate evidence or silently overwrite existing rows unsafely. Output: write-surface finding or pass.

items.title: M3: Missing-ledger policy review completed
items.context: Plan M3.a-M3.f: review ordinary single-outcome story behavior with no ledger; review structural/semantic milestone trigger behavior; review candidate versus confirmed requirements; review DEV admission and REVIEW/DONE behavior for missing or stale milestone facts; verify missing-ledger next actions are specific and non-mutating. Output: missing-state matrix.

items.title: M4: Schema and progress-model review completed
items.context: Plan M4.a-M4.f: review required milestone fields (id, source requirement, claim, doneMeans, required evidence); review checklist and verification-intent binding fields; review status values for progress tables; review parent/assigned-child story support; check prose-only text cannot produce hidden milestone claims; identify schema additions needed. Output: schema adequacy finding.

items.title: M5: Test and negative-control review completed
items.context: Plan M5.a-M5.f: find tests for milestone_status read-only behavior, missing-ledger reports, ledger set/add/get schema, milestone-triggered missing-ledger gates, and proof that milestone status cannot satisfy DONE by itself; record missing negative controls as review findings. Output: test-gap list.

items.title: M6: Agent capability impact review completed
items.context: Plan M6.a-M6.d: confirm structured milestone rows improve progress reporting, missing-ledger gates improve unattended execution safety, ledger refs improve host handoff continuity, and capability claims stop short of lifecycle DONE or Authority claims. Output: capability claim boundary.

items.title: M7: Review outcome recorded and next story decided
items.context: Plan M7.a-M7.d: summarize all pass/finding outcomes; decide whether implementation work is needed; if gaps exist draft a narrow follow-up story scope, otherwise mark documentation-only completion; update the plan document milestone statuses from planned to reviewed outcomes. Output: findings report closure section.
